query:
Hello everyone!
I’m looking for a house to buy or land with electricity and water already connected.
📍 Preferred location: Habaraduwa area
➡️ I will also consider properties from Talpe to Ahangama
Requirements:
• 4–5 bedrooms
• 4–5 bathrooms
• Maximum 2.5 km from the beach
• Clear legal status – I will verify the Title Report with my lawyer

explanations.explanation: This property is a great match for your search! It has 5 bedrooms and is only 1.3 km from Habaraduwa Beach, meeting your beach proximity requirement. It also has electricity and water connected, which you wanted. However, it has only 1 central bathroom instead of the 4-5 you requested. Overall, it aligns well with your needs!

This property in Talpe is just 150 meters from the beach, meeting your location preference. It has three bedrooms and three bathrooms, which is slightly below your request for 4-5 bedrooms and bathrooms. It also has electricity and water connected. However, it doesn't fully match your bedroom and bathroom requirements.

This property is a great match for your search! It has four bedrooms and is located just 2 km from Ahangama Beach, meeting your distance requirement. It also has electricity and water already connected. However, it only has one family bathroom instead of the requested four to five bathrooms. Overall, it offers a peaceful setting with potential for your dream home!

This property is a great match for your search! It has 4 en-suite bedrooms and is only 700 meters from Kathaluwa Beach, well within your 2.5 km limit. It also has clear legal status. However, it’s important to note that it has not yet been fully completed, which may require additional work.

Mains electricity and water are already connected, meeting your requirements. However, it has only 2 bathrooms instead of the 4-5 you requested. Overall, it’s a charming option in your desired area!

This property is a 60 perch plot of land in Habaraduwa, which is within your preferred location and just a short distance from the beach. It has clear legal status, which meets your requirement for verifying the Title Report. However, it does not have the specified number of bedrooms and bathrooms, as it is land rather than a house.

This property is a great match for your search! It has 4 bedrooms and 5 bathrooms, fitting your requirement perfectly. It's located near the beach, and the lush garden offers a beautiful setting. However, please confirm if electricity and water are connected, as that detail wasn't specified. Overall, it aligns well with your preferences!

query:
Looking for a house to rent in Ahangama – from 21 February (2–3 months)
Hi everyone,
We are currently looking for a new house to rent in Ahangama from 21 February for 2–3 months.
Requirements:
• 3 bedrooms
• 2 bathrooms
• Full kitchen
• Air conditioning in all bedrooms
• Living room with sofa
• Small garden and terrace space
Budget: Up to 350,000 LKR per month
We are a quiet family and will take good care of the house.

explanations.explanation: This property was recommended because it offers 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, which exceeds your requirement for 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms. The monthly rent of Rs. 130,000 is well within your budget. However, it is located in Ragama, not Ahangama, and it does not mention air conditioning in all bedrooms or a small garden.

This property is a cozy studio in Ahangama, available for rent at Rs 130,000 per month, which fits your budget. It includes air conditioning, a full kitchen, and a living area. However, it only has one bedroom and is designed for a maximum of three occupants, which doesn't fully meet your request for a 3-bedroom house.

This property is located in Ahangama, matching your desired area. It has five bedrooms, exceeding your requirement of three, and a kitchen. However, it is for sale, not for rent, and lacks air conditioning and a small garden, which are important for your needs. The budget is also not applicable since it's a sale listing.

This property was recommended because it has 2 bathrooms and is located in a quiet area, which aligns with your preference for a peaceful environment. However, it only has 2 bedrooms instead of the requested 3, and it is also unfurnished. Additionally, the rental period is a minimum of one year, which does not match your 2-3 month requirement.

This property is located in Ahangama, matching your desired location. It has 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, exceeding your requirements. However, it is for sale, not for rent, and is partially completed, which may not suit your need for a ready-to-move-in home. Additionally, it lacks a small garden and terrace space.

This property is recommended because it has four bedrooms and air conditioning in each, meeting your need for space and comfort. It's located in Ahangama, close to the beach, which aligns with your desired location. However, it has four bedrooms instead of three, and it’s for sale rather than for rent, which may not fit your rental needs.

This property is recommended because it offers a spacious living room and a convenient location, which aligns with your need for a quiet home. However, it only has 2 bedrooms and 1 small additional room, falling short of your 3-bedroom requirement. The rent is well within your budget, but it lacks a garden and air conditioning in all bedrooms.

This property was recommended because it has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, meeting your requirements. It also features a full kitchen and air conditioning in all rooms. However, it's located in Kurana, not Ahangama, which may not be ideal for you. Additionally, while it has a garden, it may not be the small garden you envisioned.

This property is recommended because it is located in Ahangama and has 4 bedrooms and 3 bathrooms, exceeding your requirements. It features a full kitchen and a large terrace, which is great for outdoor space. However, it does not have air conditioning in all bedrooms, and the budget of 350,000 LKR may need to be confirmed.

This property is a cozy studio annex in Ahangama, available for long-term rental at Rs 120,000 per month, well within your budget. It includes air conditioning, a small garden, and a living area with a couch. However, it only has one bedroom and one bathroom, which doesn't fully meet your requirement for three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
